changes.evidence: Freed of Whitehall's control in prison, Creel is recruited by Talbot as his personal bodyguard and works for the ATCU in S3 (S3E12 'The Inside Man', episode 56: 'Talbot and Creel returned to the ATCU'). He resigns after Talbot is shot (S4 finale), and Hale recruits him back into Hydra's fold in S5 (S5E11). The record has no stage between the two HYDRA stages.

In S5 (episode 109 range), once Creel learns S.H.I.E.L.D. did not shoot Talbot, he turns on Hale and helps Coulson and Talbot escape her custody; he is not with Hale's Hydra after that and dies when Graviton absorbs him.

Malick left the World Security Council just before the Hydra Uprising (Captain America: The Winter Soldier) and became an advisor to President Ellis; in AoS S3 he is a former councilman and a Hydra head, so the final World Security Council stage from S3 is wrong.

After escaping, Ward rejoins Hydra under Whitehall, but 'he left the organization again after Whitehall's death along with Kara Palamas' (S2E10 onward, 'Lone Wolf'/'Closure of Kara Palamas', S2E14-S2E22). In S3 (S3E2 onward) he rejoins Hydra's remnants and rebuilds it as its leader, until Coulson kills him (episode 54).

After Fennhoff's plot fails, Dottie stays in the US and becomes a freelance operative; in S2 she is hired to rob a bank for the Council of Nine's pin (S2E1, episode 9), and Masters tells her Leviathan views her as an embarrassment and Stalin will never forgive her betrayal, an 'assassin without a country' (S2E7, episode 15). Wiki lists Leviathan as former.

owner_calls.question: In AoS S3 (episode 62, S3E18 'The Singularity'), James undergoes Terrigenesis and joins Hive's Inhuman army (with Giyera, both filed under HYDRA here) until Hive dies. Should a stage for that be added before Watchdogs S4?
options: Add ["HYDRA", "Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3"] before Watchdogs S4 (matches how Hive and Giyera are filed)
Add a separate Hive's-faction group at S3
Keep as is (he tells May 'I'm not Hydra')
owner_calls.evidence: Under Hive's orders he lures Watchdogs, takes a missile silo with Giyera and flies a Hydra plane; he tells May he is not Hydra but one of Hive's original Inhuman picks. In S4 he deals with the Watchdogs (Watchdogs S4 stage is correct).
